meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 装上后,它能按要求制作约10秒的短视频动画:动态文字、数字跳动、数据图表、Logo展示、地图高亮或网页/推文模拟;自动完成规划、设计与生成,验证后询问是否渲染成 MP4 或透明背景视频。
howto.when: 当你想做一段约10秒、不带旁白的动态图形短视频(如文字运动、数据图表或Logo动画等)时触发;更长、有旁白或多场景内容会转去其他技能。

say.text: 把这句话做成8秒的动态文字视频,不要旁白。
say.note: 会生成动态排版草稿并询问预览或渲染。

say.text: 用这些销售数据做一个动起来的柱状图。
say.note: 归入图表动画,以短MP4交付。

say.text: 把这条推文做成一个会动的卡片。
say.note: 调用推文卡片模板来呈现。

howto.what_en: Claude makes short (~10s) motion videos from text, numbers, charts, logos, maps, or web/tweet items; it plans, designs and builds automatically, then asks before rendering MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggers on short, non-narrated motion-graphic requests (~10s): kinetic text, charts, or logo animation. Longer/narrated jobs go to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make this quote an 8-second kinetic-type video, no voice-over.
say_en.note: It will plan the type animation and ask before rendering.

say_en.text: Turn these sales figures into a moving bar-chart animation.
say_en.note: Uses the charts route and delivers a short MP4.

say_en.text: Animate this tweet as a moving card.
